# Fixture provenance

The fixture projects under this directory (`options`, `menu`, `resolution`,
`unsupported`, `malformed`, `assets`, `nested-styles`) are copied verbatim from
the `fixtures/projects/` directory of
[jethac/uxml-editor](https://github.com/jethac/uxml-editor)
at commit `819d9c8d11bd6c50e326797055b80fd8b0cf250d`, licensed Apache-2.0. The
upstream license text is preserved in `LICENSE` in this directory.

They are used only as test inputs; they are not part of the addon runtime.
